role: typed path and provenance resolver for external conversation transcripts

ownership.typescript: validates profile-backed transcript roots, derives provider-specific path slugs, maps PTY capture UUIDs to regular JSONL files, and selects timestamp-window candidates with deterministic newest-file fallback
ownership.shell: preserves historical function names and forwards primitive arguments to the compiled TypeScript CLI; it owns no profile parsing, path resolution, file discovery, or fallback behavior
ownership.external_cli: the PTY capture command remains a required external process boundary; transcript JSONL schema and content remain CLI-owned

invariants: a profile without an explicit log_path degrades capture and does not guess a provider root
PTY capture UUIDs resolve only to regular JSONL files under the configured root
Codex transcript discovery is limited to the configured date partition
the historical plus or minus 30 second selection window precedes deterministic newest-file fallback
the shell boundary has no parsing or fallback implementation
deletion_gate: remove lib/session-log-resolver.sh after every source-based caller invokes runner-session-log-resolver.js directly
